interface Base { name?: string; }
interface Derived extends Base { name: string | undefined; }
const item: Derived = { name: undefined };
interface First { value?: number; }
class First { value?: number; }
class Second { data?: number; }
interface Second { data?: number; }
interface HasMethod { method(value: number): string; }
class HasMethod { method(value: string | number): string { return String(value); } }
interface OnlyDeclared { method(): void; }
class OnlyDeclared {}
console.log(item.name, new First().value, new Second().data, new HasMethod().method(1), typeof new OnlyDeclared().method);
